只改显示名，不会重命名手机上的文件或文件夹。: Only changes the display name; files and folders on your phone are not renamed.
先打开广播开关，其他设备才能下载: Turn on broadcasting first so other devices can download it
「{name}」将从共享项中移除；手机上的文件不会被删除。: “{name}” will be removed from shared items; files on your phone are not deleted.
同一局域网里的设备用浏览器打开即可下载，不需要配对。: Any device on the same LAN can download it in a browser; no pairing needed.
只改共享项显示名，不改手机上的文件名。: Only changes the displayed share name, not the file name on your phone.
只取消共享，不会删除手机上的文件。: Only stops sharing; files on your phone are not deleted.
已打开系统设置：打开「所有文件访问」后返回: Opened system settings: turn on “All files access”, then come back
只共享你选中的这一项；手机上的其他文件不会因为授权而被共享。: Only the item you select is shared; other files on your phone are not shared just because access was granted.
直接共享手机目录需要 Android 11 及以上；这台系统版本不支持。: Sharing folders directly requires Android 11 or newer; this system version is not supported.
OrbDrop 只会共享你在这里明确选择的文件或文件夹；权限本身不会读取或上传任: OrbDrop only shares the files or folders you explicitly select here; the permission itself does not read or upload anything.
点「添加共享项」选择手机上的文件或文件夹；打开广播后，已连接设备就能看到。: Tap “Add shared item” to pick files or folders on your phone; once broadcasting is on, connected devices can see them.
只显示前 {n} 项，进入子目录继续查看。: Showing the first {n} items; open a subfolder to see the rest.
已有共享项在重新授权前暂时读不到。: Existing shares can't be read until access is granted again.
